title: Integral vanishing cycles from periods on conifold smoothings

abstract_html: We give a terminating construction of the marked integral vanishing-cycle homomorphism for a six-parameter family of Calabi–Yau conifold smoothings in P3×P3. Its eight local spheres span a primitive rank-six lattice in free middle homology of rank 134. Integral topology determines its symplectic normal form and torsion-free quotient. The period construction recovers its coordinates in an independently constructed geometric marking. Starting from algebraically selected equations, we construct a known neighbourhood in vanishing-period coordinates, a geometric symplectic marking, and absolute error bounds for transport and integration of represented cycles. Picard–Lefschetz period jumps recover the integral columns and monodromy without an a priori bound on the integral coordinates or a restriction on nonzero period ratios. The recovered matrix is constant in the transported marking, so recovery at one reference fibre suffices throughout the smooth family. On a possibly ineffective smaller neighbourhood, we verify applicability of established Ricci-flat Hodge, Hermitian–Yang–Mills flow and harmonic moduli results, and identify the kernel of the recovered map with the divisor restriction image governing the weak Hodge energy.
